note: RS with a resistivity unit is a shallow resistivity
RS without unit or as a volume ratio (scf/STB, m3/m3) in a PVT table is the solution gas-oil ratio
RS without unit inside a log file (LAS, DLIS, LIS, WITSML) is read as a shallow resistivity
RS in any other table (PVT) keeps the original meaning: solution gas-oil ratio
Rw with a resistivity unit is the formation water resistivity
Rw with a length unit is the wellbore radius
Rw without unit inside a log file is a petrophysical water resistivity
Rw in a well-test table keeps the original meaning: wellbore radius
BHT with a length unit is block height (Pason drilling LAS)
BHT with a temperature unit keeps the original meaning: bottom-hole temperature
BHT without unit keeps the original meaning
DEPTH in a WITSML drilling log is the hole depth
DEPTH as the index of a LAS, DLIS or LIS log is the measured depth
DEPTH in other tables is read as measured depth
TIME in a log file (LAS, DLIS, LIS, WITSML) is the time index (timestamp or elapsed seconds of the recording)
TIME in a well-test table keeps the original meaning: elapsed test time
MFOP with a flow-rate unit is a flow rate out
MFOP in percent (or without unit) is the flow-out paddle percentage
Rig heave: some Volve logs declare it unitless, but the values are in metres
MWIN with a density unit is the mud weight in
MWIN with a conductivity unit is the mud conductivity in (4 Volve logs)
GRR with a gamma-ray unit (API, GAPI) is a calibrated gamma ray: KGS 'GAMMA RAY FROM RESISTIVITY', 14 files, median 63 gAPI; in 1/s or without unit it stays gr_raw_counts
GRR is a raw gamma ray count rate (1/s or no unit), not gAPI
ROPI declared fph (1 KGS file) is a rate, not an inverse ROP; left unassigned
ROPI is an inverse ROP (s/m), not a rate of penetration
RT is read as the deep (true) resistivity; in two Volve files it is the ARC 40-in. phase-shift resistivity, the deepest reading of that tool
ROP declared in a slowness unit (min/ft, s/m) is an inverse ROP: drilling time per length, not a rate (LAS with ROP in min/ft, medians 0.6-0.8)
ROP in any other unit keeps the original meaning: rate of penetration
C1 in a fraction unit (ppm, %) is methane from the mud gas (LAS with C1 in ppm, medians 1168-124445)
C1 in a length unit or without unit keeps the original meaning: caliper 1
ITT in a slowness unit is an interval transit time (1 KGS file, US/F, median 80)
NEU in CPS (1166 KGS files, median 432) is a neutron count rate, not API neutron units nor a porosity; left unassigned
NEU in a fraction unit is a neutron porosity (Volve, v/v)
NEU in counts, API or without unit is the old uncalibrated neutron log (KGS, GDR, WVGS)
SCAL declared GAPI (164 KGS files, median 3.7) is not a caliper length; left unassigned
SCAL with a length unit is a caliper (KGS SWN Caliper, median 6.9 in)
CS with a velocity unit is the cable (logging) speed
CS in PSI is a compressive strength (2 KGS files)
CAL with a length unit is a caliper (KGS, GDR, WVGS; 166 of 166 files with a unit are in inches)
C2 in a fraction unit (ppm, %) is ethane from the mud gas (1 KGS file)
C2 in a length unit or without unit is caliper 2 (KGS, WVGS, IODP; median 11.6 in)
TOTGAS in SCF/TON is the gas content of the rock (WVGS); otherwise it keeps total_gas

DCAL in KGS LAS mixes a caliper (file medians 6-10 in) and a differential caliper (medians 0-3 in, 2349 of 8506 files); neither the unit (IN, in, GAPI) nor the description separates them, so it is left unassigned
DCAL in any other dataset is the differential caliper (FORCE 2020, IODP, Fallon, FORGE, MSEEL: medians 0 to 0.7 in)
DCAL without a known dataset is left unassigned: caliper in KGS, differential caliper elsewhere
DPLS in a fraction unit is a density porosity (KGS: medians 10.5 % and 0.11 to 0.23 v/v)
DPLS in count-rate units is the HLDS long-spaced dead-time pulse count rate (IODP, Fallon: medians 600 to 970 1/s); DPLS without a fraction unit is left unassigned
GR in a count rate (CPS, 225 KGS and 7 IODP files) or a force or length unit cannot be gAPI: raw counts or a mislabelled unit, never converted; left unassigned
GAMMA in CPS (1 KGS file) cannot be gAPI; left unassigned
SGR in 1/s (13 IODP files, NGT window count rates) is not gAPI; left unassigned
CGR in 1/s (13 IODP files) is not gAPI; left unassigned
GRD declared in OHMM (3 KGS files, medians 7.4) is not a gamma ray in gAPI; left unassigned
GRTH declared GAPI (4 KGS files) is not a thorium concentration in ppm; left unassigned
GRUR declared GAPI (4 KGS files) is not a uranium concentration in ppm; left unassigned
GRPO declared GAPI (1 KGS file) is not a potassium concentration in %; left unassigned
RILD declared in a conductivity unit (2 files, medians -372 and 1000) is not a resistivity; OWD never inverts without a documented rule; left unassigned
RILM declared in mS/m (1 IODP file, median -320) is not a resistivity; left unassigned
ILD declared in mmho (2 IODP files, median -255) is not a resistivity; left unassigned
ILM declared in mmho (2 IODP files) is not a resistivity; left unassigned
RES(GRD) in CPS (3 KGS files, median 6930) is not a resistivity; left unassigned
COND(DI) in CPS (430 KGS files, median 14100) is not a conductivity in mS/m; left unassigned
COND(MI) in CPS (2 KGS files) is not a conductivity; left unassigned
CILM declared in OHMM (1 WVGS file) while its description says conductivity; OWD never inverts; left unassigned
NPHI in counts (CNTS, 1 KGS file) is not a porosity; left unassigned
NEUT in CPS or CPM (10 KGS files) is a neutron count rate, not API neutron units; left unassigned
CALI declared DEC (1 KGS file) is not a length; left unassigned
DEN declared in % (2 KGS files, median 12) is not a bulk density; left unassigned
DPHI declared in G/C3 (3 WVGS files) or IN (1 KGS file) is not a porosity fraction; left unassigned
BS declared LBF (1 KGS file) is not a bit size; left unassigned
ECD declared in m (3 IODP files, median 0) is not a density; left unassigned
VSH declared us/f (2 WVGS files) is not a volume fraction; left unassigned
ROP5 declared min/ft (1 KGS file) is an inverse rate; OWD never inverts; left unassigned
MDT in KGS is MonoDeltaT, a monopole compressional slowness (6 files, uspf, median 71 us/ft), not a formation pressure
DP with a fraction unit is a density porosity (KGS 'Lithology Density Porosity', 5 files, %, median 6.3 %); with a pressure unit it stays delta_p
DP with a pressure unit is the pressure change of a well test (delta_p), as before the fraction rule
PD_GRAV is the PowerDrive raw gamma ray average (Volve; 10 files in 1/s, median 60): a raw count rate, also when no unit is declared
SSGR is the HNGS statistical uncertainty of the standard gamma ray (IODP, medians 0.5 to 2.3), not a gamma ray; left unassigned
ITT in a time unit or without unit is an integrated transit time (0/1 blips in KGS, cumulative seconds in Schlumberger files); no variable
TEMP in CPS (17 KGS files, median 29000) is the raw sensor count of a second TEMP curve next to TEMP in DEG F; left unassigned
NPHI declared API (1 WVGS file, median 350) is an old neutron log in API units, not a porosity
HV is the tool head voltage (230-300 V); no variable
ACTC in a slowness unit is the compensated sonic transit time (1 KGS file, median 68 us/ft)
ACTC without a slowness unit is the Volve rig mode code (values 1-9); no variable
DPSS in a fraction unit is density porosity on sandstone matrix (KGS, 2.65 g/cc)
DPSS in counts is the HLDS short-spaced dead-time pulse count rate (IODP); left unassigned
TT1 is the raw transit time from transmitter 1 to receiver 1 (200-1000 us); no variable
DCHV is a chromatograph sample TVD in Volve and a DC head voltage in IODP and Fallon; no variable
DI in a resistivity unit is the deep induction resistivity (KGS)
DI in a length unit is the diameter of invasion (Halliburton and Schlumberger); no variable
IRMN is a raw medium induction in-phase measurement (IODP, mS/m) or a casing minimum internal radius (in); no variable
Raw dual-coil conductivity of the LDEO MSS tool (volts or uncalibrated mS/m); no variable
GR7 is the NGT spectral window 7 count rate (IODP; the gAPI files carry the same values, 0.08-0.43); no variable
GRR_CAL in counts (IODP CDR, median 26 1/s) is not in gAPI; left unassigned
GR_CDR_CAL in counts (IODP CDR, median 41 1/s) is not in gAPI; left unassigned
QLRA is the Rxo/Rt quicklook ratio normalised to SP (dimensionless; the API and OHMM labels are wrong); no variable
NOIS is a tool noise channel (spectral noise in CPS); no variable
The name -- is a placeholder (KGS files where it is TVD or gamma ray); never assigned
BVILINE is the NMR BVI cut-off, a constant parameter (33 ms, 70 or 90); no variable
VS is the directional survey vertical section (ft) in KGS and WVGS and a shear velocity (ft/s) in one GDR file; no variable
COMP is the KGS density compensation (DEN COMPENSATION) in G/CC, a density correction; any other unit stays unassigned (the name is generic)
COMP without a density unit is not the density compensation; never assigned (generic name)
GRE in gAPI is the gamma ray of the Applied Petrophysics (Weatherford) pulsed neutron processing; any other unit stays unassigned
GRE without a gamma ray unit: never assigned
SVEL with a velocity unit is the sonic (compressional) velocity
SVEL in ms/f (WVGS, medians 48-61) is a slowness with a wrong label, and without unit the scale is unknown; never assigned
SWPOR is the KGS sidewall neutron (SWN) porosity; with a porosity unit (PU) it is a neutron porosity
SWPOR without unit: about 150 KGS files, some with count-rate values; never assigned
SWLS is the KGS sidewall neutron (SWN) porosity; with a porosity unit (PU) it is a neutron porosity
SWLS without unit: about 150 KGS files, some with count-rate values; never assigned
SWSS is the KGS sidewall neutron (SWN) porosity; with a porosity unit (PU) it is a neutron porosity
SWSS without unit: about 150 KGS files, some with count-rate values; never assigned
SWDL is the KGS sidewall neutron (SWN) porosity; with a porosity unit (PU) it is a neutron porosity
SWDL without unit: about 150 KGS files, some with count-rate values; never assigned
